description: Player profile page with personal stats and score history accessible by clicking username

userStories.title: Create profile.html page shell with auth check
userStories.description: As a player, I want a dedicated profile page so that I can view my personal stats and history.
acceptanceCriteria: Create profile.html that loads style.css, Supabase CDN (unpkg), config.js, and a new profile.js
Page has the same dark background (#0a0a1a) and centered layout as the game page
Page displays a centered title area for the player's username
A 'Back to Game' link navigates back to index.html
profile.js initializes the Supabase client and checks auth via getSession()
If no session exists, redirect to index.html immediately
If session exists, fetch username from profiles table and display it as the page title
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Display player stats
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see my key statistics so that I can track my overall performance.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile page shows a stats section with 5 stats: All-Time High Score, Today's High Score, Average Score, Highest Wave, Total Games Played
All-time high uses PostgREST aggregate: score.max() filtered by player_id
Today's high uses score.max() filtered by player_id and played_at >= start of today UTC
Average score uses score.avg() filtered by player_id, rounded to nearest integer
Highest wave uses wave.max() filtered by player_id
Total games uses score.count() filtered by player_id
Stats are displayed in a grid/card layout with label above and value below
Values use the blue accent color (#4a9eff)
If the player has no scores, each stat shows '—' or 0
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Display recent score history
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see my recent scores so that I can track my improvement over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile page shows a 'Recent Games' section below the stats
Fetches last 20 scores from scores table filtered by player_id, ordered by played_at descending
Each row shows: score, wave reached, and date/time (formatted like 'May 14, 2:30 PM')
Table styling reuses the .lb-table class from style.css for consistency
If no scores exist, show 'No games played yet'
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Link username to profile page
userStories.description: As a player, I want to click my username on the start screen to view my profile.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Welcome, [username]' text in the start screen (#authWelcome) becomes a clickable <a> link to profile.html
Link is styled with the existing blue color (#4a9eff), underline on hover
Clicking navigates to profile.html
The link only appears when the user is authenticated (existing behavior preserved)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
